text.p: Tenneco Inc said Thursday it completed the merger of Tenneco Energy with El Paso Energy Corp's El Paso Natural Gas Co and the spin-off of the company's Newport News Shipbuilding unit, as well as its combined automotive parts, packaging and administrative services businesses, as separate companies.
With the spin-offs and merger that closed at 0800 EST/1300 GMT, Tenneco common shareowners receive:
1) One share of "new Tenneco," the automotive parts and packaging businesses, for each share of current Tenneco stock;
2) One share of Newport News Shipbuilding Inc NNS.N for every five shares of currently held Tenneco stock; and
3) 0.093 of a share of El Paso Energy Corp for each share of Tenneco.
Holders of $7.40 preferred shares and $4.50 preferred shares receive 2.365 shares of El Paso for every preferred share of Tenneco.
Shares of both "new" Tenneco and Newport News Shipbuilding began trading Thursday on the New York Stock Exchange, the company said.
The restructuring transactions were approved by Tenneco shareowners on Tuesday, it noted.
